lines.zh: 翅膀撕开赫尔维蒂的风，我去巡视浮岛。
lines.en: My wings tear through Helvetia's wind; I go to patrol the floating isles.

lines.zh: 甲壳在气流里咔哒作响，像一串小铃。
lines.en: My chitin clicks in the airflow like a string of small bells.

lines.zh: 我从浮岛边缘滑出去，再借风爬回来。
lines.en: I slide off the island's edge, then ride the wind back up.

lines.zh: 六片薄翅每秒扇很多次，别数了。
lines.en: Six thin wings beat many times a second; do not bother counting.

lines.zh: 我贴着树冠飞，专挑没人的那条线。
lines.en: I skim the canopy, choosing the route nobody else uses.

lines.zh: 高度是我的朋友，地面从来不是。
lines.en: Height is my friend; the ground has never been.

lines.zh: 转弯时我会侧过身子，让甲壳先走。
lines.en: When I turn, I lean aside and let my chitin lead.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀没有羽毛，只有一层薄膜。
lines.en: My wings carry no feathers, only one thin membrane.

lines.zh: 我在空域里绕第三圈，只为找一股上升风。
lines.en: I circle this airspace a third time, hunting one rising current.

lines.zh: 浮岛之间没有路，只有我这样的飞法。
lines.en: There are no roads between islands, only flying like mine.

lines.zh: 别站在我下方，我落点算得不准。
lines.en: Do not stand beneath me; my landings are not precise.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我就从空中掉半格。
lines.en: The moment I fold my wings, I drop half a block.

lines.zh: 我挂在浮岛底下的石缝里歇翅膀。
lines.en: I hang in a crack beneath the island and rest my wings.

lines.zh: 甲壳上有旧划痕，是上一场俯冲留下的。
lines.en: Old scratches on my chitin remember my last dive.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂的天没有云，只有更远的岛。
lines.en: Helvetia's sky has no clouds, only farther islands.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀摊开，让风替我降温。
lines.en: I spread my wings and let the wind cool me.

lines.zh: 下面全是空，我却一点也不怕。
lines.en: Nothing but emptiness below, and I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 我在数远处的岛，数到第七个就忘了。
lines.en: I count distant islands and lose the number at seven.

lines.zh: 静下来时，甲壳里能听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: When I go still, I hear my heartbeat inside the chitin.

lines.zh: 有只同类飞过，我们互相看了一眼就走。
lines.en: Another of my kind passes; we glance and move on.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨前肢，把甲壳边缘磨利。
lines.en: I rub my forelimbs, sharpening the rim of my shell.

lines.zh: 这片天空太干净，连回声都没有。
lines.en: This sky is so clean it returns no echo.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，正好给我量俯冲角度。
lines.en: Standing still like that, you give me a perfect dive angle.

lines.zh: 我在看你的肩膀，那里最容易落爪。
lines.en: I watch your shoulder; that is where my claws land best.

lines.zh: 你的头顶很开阔，没有树叶挡着。
lines.en: Your head is open to the sky, with no leaves in the way.

lines.zh: 我歪头不是好奇，是在算距离。
lines.en: My tilted head is not curiosity, it is arithmetic.

lines.zh: 你抬头的动作太慢，我已经绕到背后。
lines.en: You look up too slowly; I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 别朝我挥手，那只会让我更想扑。
lines.en: Do not wave at me; it only makes the dive tempting.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛跟着我转，脖子会酸的。
lines.en: Follow me with your eyes and your neck will ache.

lines.zh: 我盯你三秒，就已经选好了落点。
lines.en: Three seconds of watching and my landing point is chosen.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: You carry a smell of iron that I dislike.

lines.zh: 我在你上方停住，像一枚悬着的壳。
lines.en: I hover above you, a shell suspended in the air.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了一道，但还没掉下来。
lines.en: My shell has cracked, but no piece has fallen yet.

lines.zh: 疼，可我在空中，不能停。
lines.en: It hurts, but I am airborne and cannot stop.

lines.zh: 你打中翅根了，我飞得歪了一点。
lines.en: You hit my wing root, and my flight went crooked.

lines.zh: 我掉了几片壳屑，回头再捡。
lines.en: A few shell flakes fell; I will collect them later.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了你的手速。
lines.en: That blow taught me the speed of your hand.

lines.zh: 我的壳挡了大半，剩下的才是疼。
lines.en: The shell took most of it; the rest is pain.

lines.zh: 别以为我会掉下去，我还能拉升。
lines.en: Do not think I will fall; I can still climb.

lines.zh: 伤在侧面，正好是我最难够到的地方。
lines.en: The wound is on my flank, exactly where I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我发出尖细的一声，那不是求饶。
lines.en: I let out a thin cry, and it is not surrender.

lines.zh: 还能飞，就还能再来一次。
lines.en: If I can still fly, I can come again.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我不吃，我只喝风。
lines.en: I do not eat what you hold; I drink the wind.

lines.zh: 别拿面包晃我，我的牙不长那样。
lines.en: Do not wave bread at me; my teeth are not shaped for it.

lines.zh: 甲壳质是我掉的，不是你喂的。
lines.en: That chitin fell off me; you did not feed it to me.

lines.zh: 我不馋，我只是在等你放松警惕。
lines.en: I am not tempted; I am waiting for your guard to drop.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我顺便记下你手臂位置。
lines.en: Raise it high, and I note where your arm is.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，风才是我的饭。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; wind is my meal.

lines.zh: 我不靠近你手里的东西，我靠近你。
lines.en: I am not closing on your hand, I am closing on you.

lines.zh: 那玩意儿闻起来像泥土，我飞高一点。
lines.en: That thing smells of soil, so I fly a little higher.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我俯冲一次就够了。
lines.en: Keep it; one dive is all I need.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的手，直接冲你的后颈。
lines.en: I go around your hand and straight for your neck.

lines.zh: 撞上来的是甲壳，我的身体在后面。
lines.en: The chitin hits first; the rest of me follows.

lines.zh: 疼的是你，我的壳只是响了一声。
lines.en: You feel the pain; my shell only makes a sound.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的头盔擦过去，留了道白痕。
lines.en: I graze your helmet and leave a pale streak.

lines.zh: 别推我，我在空中站不稳。
lines.en: Do not shove me; I am unsteady in the air.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两块石头对敲。
lines.en: We collide like two stones struck together.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀顶到了我的翅根，飞歪了。
lines.en: Your shoulder caught my wing root and I veered off.

lines.zh: 我不是故意的，风把我推了过来。
lines.en: It was not on purpose; the wind pushed me into you.

lines.zh: 甲壳互相刮了一下，声音很脆。
lines.en: Our shells scrape once, and the sound is crisp.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就能重新拉起高度。
lines.en: Step back half a pace and I can climb again.

lines.zh: 撞完我就往上飞，绝不在地上纠缠。
lines.en: After a collision I climb; I never brawl on the ground.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂的天空里，我从不结伴。
lines.en: In Helvetia's sky I never keep company.

lines.zh: 同类靠近我，我也会先亮出甲壳。
lines.en: When my kind comes near, I show my shell first.

lines.zh: 没有季节，也就没有那种事。
lines.en: There are no seasons here, so there is none of that.

lines.zh: 我的巢只是一个石缝，装不下两只。
lines.en: My nest is one stone crack, too small for two.

lines.zh: 我们只在争同一股上升风时见面。
lines.en: We meet only when contesting the same updraft.

lines.zh: 翅膀碰翅膀，那叫打架，不叫亲近。
lines.en: Wing against wing is a fight, not affection.

lines.zh: 我一生只认自己的飞行路线。
lines.en: I keep faith only with my own flight path.

lines.zh: 让我给孩子留个位置？先赢过我。
lines.en: Make room for offspring? Beat me first.

lines.zh: 孤独的飞法更省力，我算过。
lines.en: Flying alone costs less effort; I have done the math.

lines.zh: 别替我操心，浮岛上的空位多得很。
lines.en: Do not worry for me; the islands have room to spare.

lines.zh: 地上那片甲壳是我的，别捡。
lines.en: That chitin on the ground is mine; leave it.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下来，只为叼回自己掉的碎片。
lines.en: I dive only to retrieve a fragment I shed.

lines.zh: 碎片能补我的壳，可惜我手不够长。
lines.en: Fragments would patch my shell, but my reach is short.

lines.zh: 你放下那块甲壳质，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Set the chitin down and I will pretend I missed you.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只用嘴，从不用手。
lines.en: I pick things up with my mouth, never my hands.

lines.zh: 掉在草里的碎屑，我一片片找回来。
lines.en: I recover every crumb that fell into the grass.

lines.zh: 那不是战利品，那是我身上的一部分。
lines.en: That is not loot; it is a piece of me.

lines.zh: 我抓起碎片飞高，怕你踩到。
lines.en: I snatch the fragment upward so you cannot tread on it.

lines.zh: 甲壳质落地会响，我听得见。
lines.en: Chitin rings when it lands, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 捡完这一片，我就回去继续巡空。
lines.en: Once this piece is gathered, I return to patrolling.

lines.zh: 找到了，那个在浮岛边上走神的家伙。
lines.en: Found one: the fool daydreaming at the island's edge.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里，你突然变得很清楚。
lines.en: In my compound eyes you suddenly come into focus.

lines.zh: 就是你了，站得那么直，像根靶子。
lines.en: You will do, standing so straight, a proper target.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的位置，风会替我保密。
lines.en: I lock your position; the wind keeps my secret.

lines.zh: 目标出现，翅膀自动收成俯冲角度。
lines.en: Target found; my wings fold into a dive angle by themselves.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，赫尔维蒂现在只剩你和我。
lines.en: I see you; Helvetia is now only you and me.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声太大，隔着两座岛都听见。
lines.en: Your footsteps carry two islands away.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会看见我已经在头顶。
lines.en: Do not turn; you will see me already overhead.

lines.zh: 我选了最省力的那条航线，通向你的背。
lines.en: I take the cheapest route, and it ends at your back.

lines.zh: 这一趟值了，你身上有值得一撞的东西。
lines.en: This trip pays off; you are worth one hard impact.

lines.zh: 目标确认，六点伤害，一次俯冲。
lines.en: Target confirmed: six damage, one dive.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，让影子先落到你脚边。
lines.en: I drop low so my shadow reaches your feet first.

lines.zh: 你还没发现我，这样最好。
lines.en: You have not noticed me yet; that is ideal.

lines.zh: 从上方看，你只有巴掌大。
lines.en: From up here you are no bigger than a palm.

lines.zh: 风把味道送到我面前了。
lines.en: The wind handed me your scent.

lines.zh: 你站在浮岛边缘，很好。
lines.en: You stand at the isle's edge. Good.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕圈，等你先动。
lines.en: I circle overhead, waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 再等半秒，你的重心就会偏。
lines.en: Half a second more and your weight will shift.

lines.zh: 俯冲要斜着来，正上方风太大。
lines.en: The dive comes at an angle; straight down the wind is too strong.

lines.zh: 我数到三就下去，你别数错。
lines.en: I go on three; do not lose count.

lines.zh: 翅膀已经绷紧，甲壳也扣好了。
lines.en: Wings taut, shell locked, everything is ready.

lines.zh: 你握剑的姿势告诉我，你怕高。
lines.en: The way you hold that sword tells me you fear heights.

lines.zh: 我绕到向阳的一面，你眯眼时就是机会。
lines.en: I swing sunward; your squint will be my opening.

lines.zh: 别盯着我，我会从你看不见的角度来。
lines.en: Do not track me; I come from the angle you cannot see.

lines.zh: 空气在我翅下压成一条线。
lines.en: The air compresses into a line beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 你的后颈没有护甲，我记下了。
lines.en: Your neck has no plate; I have noted that.

lines.zh: 我故意露个破绽，你就抬头了。
lines.en: I show a feint on purpose, and you look up.

lines.zh: 三、二……风正好。
lines.en: Three, two, and the wind is right.

lines.zh: 我收紧翅膀，让自己变得像一块石头。
lines.en: I tuck my wings and turn into something like a stone.

lines.zh: 你退到树下，那正好挡住你的退路。
lines.en: You back under the tree, which blocks your escape.

lines.zh: 我收翅，往下掉半格。
lines.en: I fold my wings and drop half a block.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我就换到背光处。
lines.en: You look up; I slide into backlight.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁绕，风小些。
lines.en: I hug the cliff where the wind dies.

lines.zh: 我数你的步子，等你转身。
lines.en: I count your paces and wait for a turn.

lines.zh: 你在跳岛上，我等你落地。
lines.en: Jump the isle. I wait for your landing.

lines.zh: 我压低到草尖那么高。
lines.en: I drop to the height of the grass tips.

lines.zh: 甲壳先到，六点伤害随后跟上。
lines.en: The chitin arrives first, six points of damage after.

lines.zh: 我从斜上方撞进你的肩膀。
lines.en: I drive into your shoulder from above the diagonal.

lines.zh: 听到了吗？那是我壳撞骨的声音。
lines.en: Did you hear that? Shell against bone.

lines.zh: 我撞完立刻拉升，不给你还手的机会。
lines.en: I climb right after impact, leaving no room to answer.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你会记住风的方向。
lines.en: The blow is light, but you will remember the wind's direction.

lines.zh: 你的剑划空了，我早就滑到侧面。
lines.en: Your sword cuts air; I slid to the side first.

lines.zh: 俯冲一次，翅膀要疼很久，值得。
lines.en: One dive hurts my wings for a long while; worth it.

lines.zh: 我把你撞得后退半步，这就够了。
lines.en: I knock you back half a step, and that suffices.

lines.zh: 别捂头，下一次我从下面来。
lines.en: Do not cover your head; next time I come from below.

lines.zh: 甲壳边缘很硬，你的护甲更硬。
lines.en: My shell edge is hard, and your armor harder.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边擦过，气流先替我叫了一声。
lines.en: I pass your ear, and the air shrieks for me.

lines.zh: 撞完我往高处飞，你追不上。
lines.en: I rise after the strike; you cannot follow.

lines.zh: 你挡得不错，可惜我换了个角度。
lines.en: You blocked well, but I changed my angle.

lines.zh: 六点伤害，一次呼吸的工夫。
lines.en: Six points of damage, the span of one breath.

lines.zh: 我撞在你盾牌的上沿。
lines.en: I strike the top rim of your shield.

lines.zh: 甲壳擦过你的颈侧。
lines.en: My shell scrapes past your neck.

lines.zh: 我钩住你的披风往上提。
lines.en: I hook your cloak and pull up.

lines.zh: 你转身时，我已经在下面。
lines.en: You turned; I was already below.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你推进了水里。
lines.en: The hit knocks you into the water.

lines.zh: 我在空中翻了个身，稳住。
lines.en: I roll once in the air and steady.

lines.zh: 我从浮岛之间的空缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the gap between floating islands.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂又多了一只巡空的壳。
lines.en: Helvetia gains one more shell patrolling its air.

lines.zh: 翅膀第一次张开，风就认出了我。
lines.en: My wings open for the first time and the wind knows me.

lines.zh: 我落在最近的浮岛上，先把壳晾干。
lines.en: I land on the nearest island and dry my shell first.

lines.zh: 这里的气流陌生，我得重新学飞。
lines.en: These currents are strange; I must learn to fly again.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有声音，只有振翅。
lines.en: I was born without a sound, only a wingbeat.

lines.zh: 上方的天空裂开一条线，我顺着它下来。
lines.en: A line opens in the sky above and I follow it down.

lines.zh: 别惊讶，我只是从别处飞过来的。
lines.en: Do not be startled; I merely flew here from elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的第一趟巡逻，从这片树冠开始。
lines.en: My first patrol starts at this canopy.

lines.zh: 浮岛边缘的石头还热着，我落了上去。
lines.en: The stone at the island's edge is warm, and I settle.

lines.zh: 风把我送到这里，我就留下了。
lines.en: The wind delivered me here; here I stay.

lines.zh: 又一片空域需要有人看着，我来。
lines.en: Another stretch of sky needs watching, so I take it.

lines.zh: 火星燎到翅膜，我立刻翻滚灭火。
lines.en: An ember catches my wing membrane and I roll to smother it.

lines.zh: 翅膀没抓住风，我直直往下坠。
lines.en: My wings fail to hold the wind and I drop straight down.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲壳缝里，我根本飞不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my shell seams and I cannot lift off.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推翻，我在半空打了两个滚。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and I tumble twice in midair.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲壳上，像一根多出来的刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell like an extra spine.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进壳里，翅膀忽然变沉。
lines.en: That power seeps into my shell and my wings grow heavy.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的是力气，不是肚子。
lines.en: I eat nothing; what starves is my strength, not my belly.

lines.zh: 雷顺着翅尖走遍全身，壳都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning runs from my wingtips through me and my shell glows.

lines.zh: 虚空在下面张开，我的翅膀终于没用了。
lines.en: The void opens below, and at last my wings are useless.
